Input image 1 is ONLY a character/style reference. Create one independent single sprite, not a crop, not a sheet, no other characters.
Style: charming handcrafted toy, bold dark navy #19283F contour, clean large flat color shapes and at most two cel-shaded bands, slight paper/wood texture, painted light from upper left. Maintain the recognizable design in the lower character lineup of the reference but simplify tiny details for legibility at 128 pixels. Camera slightly elevated three-quarter front, upright whole body, faces a little right, feet at bottom. No pedestal and no ground shadow.
Composition: square 1024x1024 PNG. Exactly one centered character fitting within x=140..884 and y=100..900, feet baseline y=900, entire silhouette and appendages visible with empty margin.
